breakFormation.name: Break Formation (hold)
breakFormation.hint: Hold while dragging a troop segment to move it on its own: the rest of the formation stays put, no arrangement area opens, and an area already up neither locks its anchor nor refuses the drop. Keep it held across several drags to reshape a troop that is not moving anywhere — shift the segments you want and leave one where it is, as Troop Movement allows. Nothing checks the result, so mind that the segments still share edges and none end up stacked. Held over a rubber-band selection it keeps every segment selected instead of narrowing to one, so a whole army can be picked up and moved at once.

dismissArrangeArea.name: Dismiss Troop Arrangement Area
dismissArrangeArea.hint: Clears the advisory area shown after a troop moves, releasing the anchor and letting segments move freely again.

troopReduced.message: {name} is reduced to {segments} segments. Maximum Hit Points are capped at {hp} until the troop recovers (after downtime, use the Recover Troop Segment macro or the module api).
troopReduced.healCapped: {name}: healing capped at {hp} HP while the troop is reduced.
troopReduced.recovered: {name} recovers to {segments} segments. Maximum Hit Points are capped at {hp} until it recovers further.
troopReduced.recoveredFull: {name} recovers to full strength. The Hit Point cap is lifted.
troopReduced.notReduced: {name} is at full strength; nothing to recover.

troopMovement.name: Enable troop movement
troopMovement.hint: Move a troop as a unit: dragging one segment carries the rest of the formation with it, and paints the advisory area the segments may rearrange within. Hold the Break Formation key (B by default) while dragging to move a single segment on its own, ignoring the formation and the area. Turn off to leave every segment moving on its own. Segment sync and the Troop Reduced automation are unaffected.

ignoreAiArt.name: Ignore AI-generated art
ignoreAiArt.hint: Art in this module is AI-generated. If checked, troops and siege weapons will not use it.

useStrategyTokens.name: Use strategy tokens for troops
useStrategyTokens.hint: Dress a dropped troop in its strategy map piece instead of its tactical battle token. Either can be swapped per token from the token HUD.
useStrategyTokens.reignmakerLocked: Locked: PF2e ReignMaker is active and assigns strategy art for its own troops.

preferTrooperArt.name: Prefer trooper artwork and tokens
preferTrooperArt.hint: When a token pack has already given a dropped troop its portrait and token through compendium art, replace them with this module's trooper art. Art picked by hand on an actor or token is always left alone.
